systems.platform: Web-based; PHP (PermitFlow / Symfony), MySQL, hosted on a Linux VPS
systems.owner: Maseru City Council; built by Computer Business Solutions (Lesotho) with Web Masters Kenya; supported by the World Bank Private Sector Competitiveness Project
systems.tiers: Maseru City Council only: architects apply, upload documents and pay online, reviewers comment and the system issues permits

note: A permit system of the capital's city council, with an online portal for architects: an application with a web front, not a connection. The document says reviewers work in it but does not say where from or how the council's office is connected.
